bio: As well as tasteful, individually designed guestrooms, Hotel Arlberg is home to this elegant restaurant, which is accessed via a separate entrance. Ornate details such as warm wood finishings, a partially painted ceiling, shapely upholstered armchairs and classic-style wall lamps create a cosy atmosphere, and this is complemented by the professional and attentive service. Then there is the Alpine-Mediterranean cuisine, which the chefs call Monte e Mare: made from the finest ingredients, it is served as a tasting menu comprising five to eight courses, also vegetarian. The fantastic wine list, which is predominantly Austrian, Italian and French, includes over 1 000 labels, with around 15 000 bottles stored in the cellar....
